title: Chicken in Mayonnaise
id: MAR-0060

time_min: 50
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g of boiled chicken breast
- 4 anchovy fillets in oil
- 3 tablespoons of mayonnaise
- 3 tablespoons of fresh cream
- 1 teaspoon of mustard
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 0.5 lemon
## Method
1. Cut the chicken into strips and squeeze the half lemon.
2. Chop the anchovies, mash them with a fork and place them in a bowl; add the oil, lemon juice, mustard, mayonnaise, and cream, and emulsify.
3. Pour the sauce over the chicken, mix, and serve.
